title: Dealer and Customer Service Experience
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly discuss dealer and customer service, with many praising excellent support while a smaller set report poor treatment or dissatisfaction and many undetermined snippets lack enough context to judge sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise dealer and brand service as excellent, great, and consistently supportive across purchase and ownership interactions.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe service as terrible, poor, and in one case perceived as discriminatory toward older customers.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews contain dissatisfaction focused on service quality, including complaints about general service and BMW Financial customer service, but the sampled fragments do not show the offsetting positive context.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention customer service or name specific dealers but do not provide enough context in the sampled fragments to confirm a clear sentiment.

limitations: The sampled evidence is dominated by short fragments, so many comments lack context about what aspect of service was good or bad.
Undetermined snippets are especially incomplete, which limits confidence in interpreting their sentiment.
The examples focus mainly on UK dealer and customer service mentions, so other countries in the topic have limited illustrative evidence.
